summary: The research agent's model provider is the miner's choice (owner decision 2026-09-26). model_provider separates the agent application from provider adapters (OpenAI Responses; any OpenAI-compatible Responses or Chat Completions endpoint the miner names), model id, settings and a credential reference to the miner's own key file or environment variable, never the key. A campaign's ModelSelection is built only through select(); the pinned gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 selection records the exact provider block and plan every existing campaign carries, so those still verify. A listed price carries its source and observation date; a miner may declare one; otherwise the spend bound is stated as unknown, no money is reserved or metered, and a money ceiling is refused. Provider failures are typed: a 429 rate limit is retried at most twice under new reservations with bounded backoff, 4xx rejections are counted with no token charge and never retried, and 5xx or unreadable outcomes keep the full reservation with no resend. The shared agent path no longer imports Burgers defaults: the historical Burgers prompt moved to its own module byte-identical, a composition naming no Challenge and a candidate naming no challenge_id are refused. agent_connection gives stdio connection instructions per tier and an in-process handshake check; Carbon does not control an external agent's lifecycle. No live provider call was made; real-model runs remain unexercised.
